rule: A commercial offer may be checkout-enabled only when payment verification, finite allocation, and the stated fulfillment gate are implemented.

approved.name: DreamLedger Founding Tile
approved.problem: Own a permanent 100x100 placement on a finite one-million-pixel Internet Billboard.
approved.input: Stripe Checkout collects billboard title and destination URL; an optional NZ$100 image add-on can be selected for manual review.
approved.output: A real 100x100 placement allocated on the finite canvas and published only after human approval.
approved.delivery_mechanism: stripe_payment -> signed_webhook -> atomic_grid_allocation -> paid_pending_review -> human_approval -> publication
approved.deliverable: Permanent 100x100 Internet Billboard placement held until January 1, 3000 unless removed under the published content policy.
approved.target_buyer: Businesses, creators, projects and internet-native collectors wanting a memorable permanent web placement.
approved.eligibility: Buyer supplies a valid destination URL and acceptable content. Image placement requires personal approval.

approved.name: Commander Deck Diagnostic

approved.eligibility: Buyer supplies valid Commander deck data.
